title: Godot Crash When Suspending on Ubuntu
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.1 and 4.6.2

### System information

Ubuntu version 24.04.4 Using an MSI Crosshair 18

### Issue description

Whenever I suspend my computer, Godot closes. I'm opening it through a .desktop file with the following inside it
```
[Desktop Entry]
Name=Godot
Exec=/home/istubedmytoe/Downloads/Godot_v4.6.1-stable_linux.x86_64
Icon=/home/istubedmytoe/Downloads/Godot_icon.png
Type=Application
Terminal=false
```

When it closes it has the following error:

### Steps to reproduce

This happens whenever I have Godot open, then suspend the computer and it reaches the lock screen

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A The issue is with the editor.
